description: Words that must never appear in another edition's landing build (frontend/app/scripts/check-edition-leak.mjs --root landing): matched case-insensitively at the start of a word. Contains every word of the app's list (frontend/app/src/editions/poly/leak-words.json, checked by editions.spec.ts) plus the landing's edition marker. Lives in this folder, so the list itself never ships in the standard build.
